messages:
Maya: FYI rolling v9.1.0-canary (token splitter tweak) and seeing token p99 jump on gpu-pool-21b, p99 +320ms.
AJ: Link to alert: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/3132101234  spike at 11:04 UTC during canary.
RuntimeBot: deploy v9.1.0-canary -> 8% at 2026-04-02T11:03:52Z
Samir: The change tightens prefix merging for code tokens; expected shorter seqs for many requests, but maybe splitting behaved differently.
PerfEng: Quick profile: host gpu-pool-21b-04 shows batcher avg_batch_size down 2.1 -> 1.7, kernel-decider oscillating between fp16_gemm and quant_int8 every ~30s.
Lina: Ops bot flagged tenant=ingest-stream-7 as high-mem on same host, long sequences (~8k tokens) during nightly ingest.
Maya: KV cache eviction rate jumped 4x; prefetcher reported repeated prefill for same keys.
PerfEng: Perf dump snippet:
```
# gpu-pool-21b-04
kernel_selector: paths_tried=[fp16_gemm, quant_int8_gemm] chosen=fp16_gemm flips=17
kvcache: hits=890 misses=1045 evictions=412
batcher: avg_batch=1.7 median=2 tail=1
memcpy_overhead_ns/token: baseline=300 canary=1200
inner_kernel_ns/token: baseline=3800 canary=5400
```
AJ: So noisy long-run ingest + tokenizer split change -> more unique prefixes -> kvcache churn and smaller batches -> higher memcpy and kernel launch overhead.
OpsBot: noisy-neighbor detector: tenant=ingest-stream-7 flagged on gpu-pool-21b-04 for sustained GPU mem alloc and long prompts.
Samir: That ingest job accidentally landed on canary hosts due to recently updated placement rules. I'll move it off canary.
Maya: Mitigations I can roll immediately: 1) evict tenant ingest-stream-7 from pool, 2) add short hysteresis to kernel-decider to avoid 30s flips, 3) temporarily pin tokenizer variant for canary.
AJ: Executing: `rctl evict-tenant --tenant=ingest-stream-7 --pool=gpu-pool-21b`
AJ: Also kicking targeted rollback of v9.1.0-canary on affected hosts.
PerfEng: Post-eviction quick-check shows kvcache evictions dropping, avg_batch climbing back toward 3, memcpy overhead reduced.
Samir: I'll open PRs: - placement rules to exclude long ingest jobs from canary, - token-prefix dedupe cache in tokenizer, - kernel-decider hysteresis + recent seqlen histogram signal.
PerfEng: Recommend telemetry: record kernel-decider flips per host and batcher homogeneity metric (seqlen stddev per batch) so we can detect this early.
Maya: I'll file incident doc and assign owners (perf-eng + Samir + AJ). Incident link: https://redwood/incidents/2026-04-02-3132101234
AJ: Monitoring; will re-roll once fixes land :thumbsup:
